QuestLog.Title: Quest Log
QuestLog.EditingNote: Editing. Changes save as you go.
QuestLog.HiddenNotice: Hidden. Players can't see this quest until you reveal it.
QuestLog.SaveFailed: Couldn't save. Check your connection and try again.

Quest.Name: Quest name
Quest.LimitedNote: You know this quest exists, but not its details.
Quest.InProgressHint: Party focus: shows this quest on everyone's Quest Beacon
Quest.DropGiver: Drop an actor, item, or journal entry
Quest.GMNotesEmpty: No GM notes yet. Add some in edit mode.
Quest.TrackHint: Follow this quest on your Quest Beacon. Only you see this.
Quest.UntrackHint: Tracking on your Quest Beacon. Click to stop.

Objective.Name: Objective
Objective.Show: Hidden from players. Click to show
Objective.HideAction: Visible to players. Click to hide
Objective.AllDoneHidden: Every objective is done. Untick Hide done to see them.

Page.EditInLog: Quests are edited in the Quest Log.

Theme.Name: Quest Log theme (just you)
Theme.Hint: Use world theme follows the GM's choice. Pick another to override it on this device only.

Textures.Name: Theme textures (just you)
Textures.Hint: Shows each theme's background textures. Turn off for smooth, flat panels.

DefaultOwnership.Name: Player access when a quest is revealed
DefaultOwnership.Hint: Hidden quests give players no access. When a quest leaves Hidden, all players get this level. Adjust single quests with Foundry's ownership controls.
DefaultOwnership.Limited: Limited: name, status, and giver only

ShowInProgress.Name: Show the Quest Beacon
ShowInProgress.Hint: Shows the party's focus quest, or quests you track, with objectives above the players list. Applies to your client only.

ShowNextObjective.Name: Show objectives on the Quest Beacon
ShowNextObjective.Hint: Lists the quest's objectives under its name on the Beacon.

AutoUnlockRewards.Name: Unlock rewards when a quest is completed
AutoUnlockRewards.Hint: Rewards start locked. When on, marking a quest Completed lets players claim its rewards.

FollowerOwnership.Name: Access granted by actor rewards
FollowerOwnership.Hint: When a player claims an actor reward (a follower or mount), they get this access to it.

WorldTheme.Name: Quest Log theme (world default)
WorldTheme.Hint: The theme everyone sees unless they choose their own. Follow Foundry matches each person's light or dark interface setting.

hideFromPlayers.Name: Hide the Quest Log from players
hideFromPlayers.Hint: Players see no Quest Log, Quest Beacon, or buttons. For GM-only quest tracking.

playerJournalButton.Name: Players: Quest Log button in the Journal tab
playerJournalButton.Hint: Show the Quest Log button at the top of the Journal tab for players.

playerSceneControl.Name: Players: Quest Log button in Token controls
playerSceneControl.Hint: Show the Quest Log button in the left toolbar's Token controls for players.

playersCanAccept.Name: Players can accept quests
playersCanAccept.Hint: Players get an Accept button on Available quests, which makes them Active. A GM must be connected.

playersCanCreate.Name: Players can propose quests
playersCanCreate.Hint: Players get a New quest button. Their quests start as Available, owned by them. A GM must be connected.

trustedCanChangeStatus.Name: Trusted players can change status
trustedCanChangeStatus.Hint: Trusted players who own a quest can start, complete, fail, or reopen it. Hiding and revealing stay with the GM.

playersEditNotes.Name: Players can edit player notes
playersEditNotes.Hint: Any player who can read a quest can edit its Player notes, even without owning it. A GM must be connected.

Font.WorldHint: Any font Foundry has, including ones uploaded under Core's Additional Fonts. Theme default uses each theme's own font.
Font.OwnHint: Use world font follows the GM's choice. Pick another to override it on this device only.

Reward.Name: Reward
Reward.Show: Hidden from players. Click to show
Reward.HideAction: Visible to players. Click to hide
Reward.GiveHint: Give this reward to a character
Reward.Unlock: Locked. Click to let players claim it
Reward.LockedNote: Locked until the GM releases it
Reward.UndoItem: Undo this claim. Take {item} back from {actor}?
Reward.NoRecipients: There's no actor to give this to. Create a character first.
Reward.NoCharacter: You don't own a character to receive this.
Reward.NeedGM: A GM must be connected to hand out rewards.

Error.NotGM: Only a GM can do that.
Error.Locked: That reward isn't available to claim yet.
Error.AlreadyClaimed: That reward has already been claimed.
Error.SourceMissing: The original item or actor no longer exists.
Error.PlayerOwned: A player owns this quest, so the GM hands out its rewards.
Error.CompendiumActor: Actor rewards must be world actors. Import the actor from its compendium first.

Reward.GMHandsOut: The GM hands out this reward
Reward.UndoItemMissing: {item} can't be found on {actor} (it may have been sold, used, or renamed). Undo the claim anyway? Remove the item by hand if it's still there.

Rejected.giver: Quest givers can be actors, items, or journal entries.
Rejected.rewards: Rewards can be items or actors.
Rejected.objectives: Only items can be dropped here.

Drop.CannotOpen: You don't have permission to open that.

Beacon.Label: Quest Beacon: {name}. Open in Quest Log.
Beacon.EmptyLabel: No quest tracked. Open the Quest Log.
Beacon.SwitchLabel: {count} marked quests. Choose which to show.

Folders.Name: Folder name
Folders.OutsideHint: These quests were moved out of the FHQL Quests journal folder.

Import.Title: Import from Forien's Quest Log
Import.Intro: These quests were found in Forien's Quest Log data. Importing adds a Fallhammer quest page to each quest's existing journal entry, so links to them keep working.
Import.Safe: FQL's own data is never changed. Quests already imported are skipped unless you tick Re-import.
Import.OverwriteHint: Replace this quest with FQL's version. Edits made here since the last import are lost.
Import.MoveOption: Move imported quests into FHQL Quests › Imported from FQL
Import.MoveHint: Recommended. FQL only reads its own hidden folder, so if you re-enable FQL later it won't see moved quests. Untick to leave them where they are; they'll show in the log under Outside FHQL Quests.
Import.NoneFound: No Forien's Quest Log quests were found in this world.

Fix.MissingParent: its parent quest no longer exists, so it's now top level.
Fix.MissingSubquest: listed a subquest that no longer exists; dropped.
Fix.AdoptedParent: had no parent, but {parent} listed it as a subquest; parent set to {parent}.
Fix.ConflictingParent: {other} also listed it as a subquest; kept its own parent, {kept}.
Fix.ParentLoop: its parents looped back to itself; made top level.
Fix.Unmapped: FQL fields with no equivalent here, not imported: {fields}.
Fix.NameDiffers: FQL's stored name was "{name}"; kept the journal entry's name.
Fix.HiddenAccess: hidden quest: player access removed so it stays hidden.
Fix.HasQuestPage: already has a Fallhammer quest page not made by this importer; left alone.

Player.NeedGM: A GM must be connected for that.
Player.Failed: That didn't go through. Try again.
Player.AcceptHint: Take on this quest. It becomes Active.

Refused.NotGM: Only a GM can do that.
Refused.NotAllowed: That isn't allowed in this world.

Deposit.ModeLabel: Players hand the item over, or only show it
Deposit.DropHint: Drop an item on an objective to require it, or here to add an objective for it.
Deposit.FromCharacter: Drag the item from a character's sheet.
Deposit.NeedGM: A GM must be online to take deposits.
Deposit.DeleteQuestion: This objective holds {qty} × {item} handed over by players. Deleting it means they can't be returned. Delete anyway?

Error.NotGM: Only a GM can take deposits.
Error.NotFound: That objective or item no longer exists.
Error.NotOwner: That item isn't on a character you own.
Error.Failed: The deposit didn't go through; nothing was taken.
Error.ActorGone: {actor} no longer exists, so the item can't be returned.

Notes.TakeOverHint: Take over the notes. Anything they haven't saved may be overwritten.

Error.Action: That didn't work. Check the console (F12) for details.

Share.Hint: Open this quest on players' screens. Only players who can see the quest get it.
Share.Title: Show this quest to
Share.Missed: Couldn't show it to {names}. They may have just disconnected.
Share.NoOne: No connected player can see this quest. Reveal it, or give them access, first.
